integrity: The construction is an explicit one-parameter family of genuine SO(3) rotations. The critical first-order side inequalities are checked exactly in Q(sqrt(3)); continuity promotes the strict negative derivatives to genuine containment for all sufficiently small positive parameters. A standalone checker replays exact derivative identities and independent finite-parameter matrix containment checks.
scientific_limitations: The explicit theorem is restricted to equilateral triangles. It does not classify locally Rupert triangles or all trivial double-arch polygons. The triangular-prism corollary relies on Scott's published prism theorem. No quantitative maximum passage clearance or largest admissible angle is claimed.
title: The equilateral triangle is locally Rupert
